system.description:
Usage worn around wrist, neck or waist.

The cord begins completely white. Each oath formally sworn upon it leaves behind a permanent-coloured thread woven inexplicably through its fibres.

You gain a +2-status bonus to saving throws against magical effects attempting to compel you to knowingly violate a solemn oath you have freely undertaken. This protection does not apply to casual promises or an oath obtained through supernatural coercion.

You also gain the Seal the Word ability:

Seal the Word:

Activate 1 minute

Frequency 1/day

Targets Up to two willing creatures

The cord casts Oathseal upon the targets. The resulting oath remains recorded as a pattern within the cord for its duration.

On the sheet: +2 status is offered on saves against compulsion to break an oath; Seal the Word is Oathseal as an innate spell, 1/day.

Pillars of Faith, Chapter 11.
